scope: Interpretation of the retained first build-setup log only
description: The isolated target path caused upstream workspace inference to resolve SDK/default/tool paths beneath .cache and start duplicate tool downloads. The operator terminated that setup and used absolute existing SDK/tools/defaults paths. No firmware build completed in that setup.
